reviews.text:
What can I say except absolutely fantastic!
My cat was pampered for a month. I was a little worried because it was the first time in 11 years that we'd left her, but she settled in very quickly and wanted to show me all her favorite spots when I went to pick her up. Yes, really, she gave me a tour of all her favorite places (so many options for them, between the baskets, cat trees, and hanging toys at different heights). Plenty of litter boxes, always clean, no odors, multiple water fountains, and a variety of toys. We received updates very often via WhatsApp.

I recommend them 100%!
Excellent boarding facility, they took great care of our cats 👏 …

Our cat, although atypical, particularly due to his shyness, was very well cared for. We received regular updates about him, which was a great pleasure. I was very satisfied with the services and will return to Cat's Étoiles Paris without hesitation.

Appolopatte spent a week at Cat's Stars boarding facility and everything went wonderfully! It was his first time staying with several cats, and everything went very smoothly thanks to Huguette and her partner. We received very regular updates, the cats are stimulated every day, and the cleanliness of the place is remarkable. My apprehension about leaving my four-legged companion quickly subsided because I knew he was in good hands. Thank you so much!
Highly recommended

This was Vanille's fourth stay at Cat's Etoiles Paris. She's always so happy to see Huguette and her husband again. She was pampered and really enjoys her group life there. For my part, I leave Vanille there without any worries. I have complete confidence. I highly recommend it.

I highly recommend this cat boarding facility! I was truly impressed by the cleanliness, organization, and quality of the facilities. There are tons of toys and accessories; everything is designed with the cats' well-being in mind. Our little cat was very well received, and the care she received was exceptional. There are really no words to describe this place; it's simply fantastic. We are so happy we found it.

My cat had a wonderful stay at Cat's Étoiles. It was incredibly reassuring to receive video updates and see how quickly he settled in and felt right at home. I recommend this cattery without hesitation!

Our cat Thésée spent five weeks at Cat's Étoiles boarding facility this summer, and we were delighted. Huguette took excellent care of him, with great attention and gentleness. We were able to leave with complete peace of mind, knowing he was in good hands. She regularly sent us adorable videos, which allowed us to stay updated and see that he was happy and thriving. A huge thank you for her professionalism and love of cats. We entrust Thésée to her without hesitation and will definitely return!

I was very satisfied with the cattery, especially since I was quite worried as my cat is timid and had never left home or seen other cats. After two days of settling in, and thanks to the patience of the hosts and the quality of the facilities, my cat felt very comfortable during that week!

My cat was safe and sound there, and she had a wonderful stay. They were very kind to her, the place was clean, and had everything a cat needed to feel comfortable. They even gave me great advice on how to care for my cat! Thank you!
Our Melusine team was very professional and welcoming. Video and message every day. We will definitely use your services again in the future.

A very warm welcome! The cattery is very clean, accommodates a limited number of cats, and is thoughtfully furnished. Chamaline thoroughly enjoyed her week there. New toys every day. Very attentive hosts, and the daily video was much appreciated. We'll be back!

It was a first experience for us and for our cat. He was very well received and pampered during that week. We received updates every day with a short video. We found him in great shape and the return home went very smoothly. We highly recommend Cat’s Etoile Paris!

My two cats stayed for about two weeks at Huguette's, and this cattery is fantastic.
The cats have a space perfectly suited to their feline nature, and they are pampered and spoiled every day.
I wouldn't hesitate to entrust my cats to her again when I'm away. Nothing but positive things to say.
Our feline friend is always delighted to spend his holidays at Cat's Etoiles :)

Lilou's first stays this summer at Cat's Etoiles.
Huguette and her husband were very attentive, caring, and went out of their way to help Lilou settle in. …

This was our first time leaving our cat in a cattery, and Huguette reassured us with her professionalism. The place is fantastic! It's very clean, and there are plenty of toys and facilities for the cats. They are pampered. I highly recommend it!

Filou spent three weeks at Cat's Étoile with lovely people who took excellent care of him. Every day they sent us a short video keeping us updated on his life. We are absolutely delighted with this cattery and will not hesitate to entrust …

Our cat Schnitzel just spent the summer at Cat's Stars cattery. The spaces and facilities dedicated to the boarders seemed perfectly suited to their needs. We received videos almost daily and found our cat perfectly happy at the end of his stay. In short, 5 stars for cats.
